title: Where the Desvigne band played
summary: They played Catholic schools, Xavier, church halls, club balls, the Artaban Tea Room, San Jacinto Hall and the Gypsy Tea Room.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And where did you all play in those days? We played different clubs.

Played all the Catholic schools. We played Xavier University. We played the prep. We played... We played... St. Catherine. That was a church auditorium. We played all the balls for the different clubs. The Illinois and our young men Illinois. And we played a lot of... A lot of different clubs around town. The Artaban Tea Room. Played that.
I remember when they used to play at the San Jacinto Hall sometimes.

Did you play some of those jobs too? Played a lot of dance at the San Jacinto and the old Gypsy Tea Room. Oh yeah. The old Gypsy Tea Room. We used to play there every weekend. And we played... There were a lot of those clubs around New Orleans. White and colored clubs.
